items.q: What time are California Lottery drawings held?
items.a: Draw times vary by game; times on this page use California local time. See the Schedule section for each game's days and times.

items.q: What is the minimum age to play the California Lottery?
items.a: You must be 18 or older to play.
California does NOT charge state income tax on lottery winnings. Federal withholding of 24% applies to prizes over $5,000.

items.q: How do I claim a California Lottery prize?
items.a: Smaller prizes can be claimed at retailers; larger prizes at a Lottery office or headquarters. See How to Claim above.

items.q: What happens to unclaimed California Lottery prizes?
items.a: Unclaimed prize funds are directed to state programs per California Lottery rules.
